name: NanoClaw
description: NanoClaw is a self-hosted personal AI assistant. Each agent session runs in its own Docker sandbox; it ships a browser chat UI with MCP + skills support and a first-run setup wizard for connecting Claude or a local model.

notes.text: The first browser login becomes the owner; the bearer token is in /opt/nanoclaw/.env (WEBCHAT_TOKEN).
First boot builds the agent container image via Docker — allow several minutes.

To sign in over Tailscale: install the Tailscale LXC addon, then open over your tailnet at :3100 — the first Tailscale login becomes owner. You can then enable HTTPS and retire the bearer token from the setup wizard / Settings.
